posts.text: I’m back from my hackathon hiatus. Two weeks ago, I competed at Mac-a-thon, where my team (Ashley Moon, Melanie Ong, and Anastasiya Volgina) built a prediction market for transit delays to channel our frustrations with the TTC. We had a great time working under a tight deadline, and a huge thanks goes to Kevin Wang from MLH for the mentorship and the funny transit stories. With that support, we were able to win the Best use of Solana. One week ago, at Hack Canada, Anastasiya Volgina, Rosie Chai,
I'm thrilled to announce that I will be interning at Shopify this term! A huge thank you to Alexa Ironside and Phil Nadon for the wonderful interview process!
